module.title: Fluid, MHD, and Multi-Moment Plasma Solvers
entrypoints: moments/luareg/ (Lua simulation inputs through the gkeyll executable)
module.expensive_path: Finite-volume wave propagation and source coupling over multi-fluid, five-/ten-moment, Maxwell, and MHD state vectors; Riemann solves, reconstruction, closures, and cell-wise updates dominate large multidimensional runs.
module.rationale: This layer is the fluid-scale plasma/MHD model family and is independently buildable above core. Its numerical method, state variables, validation problems, and acceleration opportunities differ from the phase-space kinetic solvers.
excluded: Vlasov, gyrokinetic, and PKPM phase-space solvers are separate physics modules.
General-purpose arrays, grids, I/O, and communication remain shared core infrastructure.
hazards: Some production cases use MPI or CUDA paths unavailable on the investigation host.
Regression drivers emit solution files but do not necessarily compare them to an embedded numerical baseline.
